description: This file defines the interface IOCIContainer for managing container lifecycle and notifications within the WPEFramework. It includes enums for container states, a notification interface for container events, and methods for container operations such as start, stop, pause, resume, hibernate, wakeup, execute commands, and manage properties.

classes.name: IOCIContainer
classes.description: Interface for container management operations including start, stop, pause, resume, hibernate, wakeup, execute commands, and property management.

classes.name: IOCIContainer::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for container events such as start, stop, failure, and state change.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a notification callback for container events.

methods.name: GetContainerInfo
methods.description: Get detailed information about a specific container.

methods.name: GetContainerState
methods.description: Get the current state of a specific container.

methods.name: StartContainer
methods.description: Start a container from a bundle.

methods.name: StartContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Start a container from a Dobby specification JSON.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Execute a command inside a container.

methods.name: RemoveAnnotation
methods.description: Remove a property from a container.

methods.name: Mount
methods.description: Mount a path inside a container.

methods.name: Unmount
methods.description: Unmount a path from a container.
